# `armada revision`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

List and show an app's revisions.

Also: `revisions`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada revision list`](#armada-revision-list) | List an app's revisions |
| [`armada revision show`](#armada-revision-show) | Show one revision of an app |

## `armada revision list`

List an app's revisions.

```
armada revision list APP [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Examples:

```bash
armada revision list api
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada revision show`

Show one revision of an app. REVISION is its full name, such as web--r3.

```
armada revision show REVISION [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada revision show api--r12          # image digest, platforms, secret versions
armada revision show api--r12 -o json
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
